decks.name: LeetCode #128 - Longest Consecutive Sequence
decks.description: Find the length of the longest consecutive sequence in an unsorted array

cards.question: Longest Consecutive Sequence: Given an unsorted array of integers nums, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time.

solutions.name: Hash Set Optimal
solutions.explanation: Store all numbers in a hash set. For each number, only start counting if it's the beginning of a sequence (num-1 not in set). Then count consecutive numbers. This ensures each number is visited at most twice, achieving O(n) time.

semanticLines: Define function longestConsecutive that accepts array nums.
Create set numSet from nums to enable constant time lookups.
Initialize variable longest to zero to track maximum sequence length.
Loop through each number num in numSet.
Check if num minus one is not in numSet to identify sequence start.
If true, initialize length to one for current sequence.
Start infinite while loop to count consecutive numbers.
Check if num plus length exists in numSet.
If exists, increment length by one.
If not exists, break out of while loop.
Compare length with longest, take maximum, and store in longest.
Return longest.

solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given [100,4,200,1,3,2]: Create set {100,4,200,1,3,2}. At num=100, 99 not in set, count: 100 exists, length=1, 101 not in set, stop, longest=1. At num=1, 0 not in set (sequence start), count: 1,2,3,4 all exist, length=4, 5 not in set, stop, longest=4. Skip 2,3,4 as they have num-1 in set. Result: 4.
